description: This header file declares CUDA communication functions for tensor broadcasting, scattering, and gathering in the PyTorch library.

methods.name: broadcast_out
methods.description: Outputs tensors after broadcasting a source tensor to multiple destination tensors.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a tensor to multiple devices.

methods.name: broadcast_coalesced
methods.description: Coalesces broadcasting of multiple tensors to multiple devices into fewer operations.

methods.name: scatter_out
methods.description: Outputs tensors by scattering a source tensor across multiple tensors along a dimension.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Scatters a tensor across multiple devices along a specified dimension.

methods.name: gather_out
methods.description: Gathers tensors from multiple tensors into an output tensor along a specified dimension.

methods.name: gather
methods.description: Gathers tensors from multiple tensors into a single tensor along a specified dimension.
